title: Reintroductions can backfire by destabilising food webs and triggering further extinction cascades: analysis code and simulation data
description: Annotated v0.4 reanalysis of predator reintroduction simulation data. Includes eleven fitted model specifications (nine inherited formulas and two newly reconstructed evenness models), executed PDF and Markdown results, rebuilt manuscript figure layouts, model-specific sample sizes, coefficient and prediction tables, and reproducibility documentation. The underlying simulation data are unchanged. No new Julia food-web simulations were generated. See CHANGELOG_v0.4.md and DATA_README.md for corrections and limitations.
